info.title: Sunbird RC
info.description: Sunbird RC's HTTP surface: the credentialling services (credential issuance, credential-schema and rendering templates, identity/DID), whose paths and schemas are Sunbird's own published OpenAPI documents merged verbatim, plus the registry service (entities, search, claims and attestation, attestation policies, documents), authored from its Spring controller mappings because the registry publishes no static spec (it generates per-deployment Swagger at /api/docs/swagger.json). Registry entity types are deployment-defined, so they appear as the {entityName} path parameter. The registry's /utils/sign, /utils/verify and /health share their keys with the identity service's same-purpose endpoints, which represent both.
